summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execute math_init.js which ships inside the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style transforms: a shuffled string-array rotator and a large mixed hex/char-code lookup table used to reconstruct identifiers at runtime. setup.mjs itself uses `_0xXXXX` obfuscator.io identifier naming. The package's advertised purpose is a React IoC container, which has no requirement for a second language runtime or an obfuscated multi-hundred-kilobyte payload at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — routing execution through a downloaded alien runtime to evade Node-based scanners — combined with heavy obfuscation of the executed payload is the standard delivery shape for credential theft, C2, or persistence installers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
